description: This file defines the AndroidElementNotAllowedInspection class, a custom static code analysis tool for Android XML layout files within an IDE, which checks for disallowed XML elements.

classes.name: AndroidElementNotAllowedInspection
classes.description: A custom inspection class that checks for disallowed Android XML elements in layout files.

classes.name: MyVisitor
classes.description: An inner class extending XmlRecursiveElementVisitor that traverses XML tags to identify disallowed elements.

methods.name: getGroupDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the inspection group.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of this specific inspection.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Returns the short identifier for the inspection.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Performs the inspection on a given PsiFile, returning problem descriptors for issues found.

methods.name: visitXmlTag
methods.description: Visits each XML tag to check if it is a disallowed element.

methods.name: isUnknownCustomView
methods.description: Determines if a given XML tag represents an unknown custom view based on its namespace and name.
